subject: RivetCloud onboarding - certificate scope questions & PO routing
messages:
From: RivetCloud Ops <ops@rivetcloud.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RivetCloud onboarding: initial docs & COI attached

Hi Jonas / team,

Thanks for the warm intro earlier. Per our onboarding checklist, please find our initial documents attached: Certificate of Insurance (COI), W-9, and a current subcontractor roster (v1).

Quick notes:
- General liability: $1,000,000 / occ; $2,000,000 agg on the COI.
- We have an active cyber/E&O policy - limits listed on the COI summary only.

Could you confirm the exact certificate-holder language Redwood requires and whether you need an additional-insured endorsement or primary/non-contributory wording? Also, what timing is typical for a PO to be issued once docs look good? We want to avoid delays.

Attestations: COI and W-9 signed electronically.

Attachments: rivetcloud_coi.pdf (pdf), rivetcloud_w9.pdf (pdf), subcontractor_list_v1.csv (csv)

Best,
Carmen Diaz
Head of Operations
RivetCloud
ops@rivetcloud.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RivetCloud onboarding: initial docs & COI attached

Thanks Carmen — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying items so procurement can route this for a conditional PO: 

1) Certificate holder text: please include exactly (including punctuation):
   Redwood Inference, Inc.
   140 2nd Street
   San Francisco, CA 94105

2) Endorsements we typically require (confirm if your carrier can add):
   - Additional Insured (CG 20 10/11 or equivalent) for General Liability, on a primary & non-contributory basis
   - Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference on Workers' Comp if applicable

3) Cyber/E&O: we require a minimum of $2M cyber/E&O or a documented risk acceptance from our security team. Can you confirm the exact limit and retroactive date on your policy?

4) PO timing: Procurement can issue a conditional PO within ~3-5 business days after we receive an endorsed COI and a signed SOW/contract. Final PO will be released once endorsements are on file. If you can provide an endorsed COI (or Docusign link for endorsement), we can speed things up.

If helpful, we can set a short 20-minute call to walk through the endorsement language and PO steps. Proposed times: Tue 04/27 10:00-11:00 PT or Wed 04/28 14:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

On Tue, Apr 26, 2027 at 10:03 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks Carmen — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying items so procurement can route this for a conditional PO:
>
> 1) Certificate holder text: please include exactly (including punctuation):
>    Redwood Inference, Inc.
>    140 2nd Street
>    San Francisco, CA 94105

Hi Jonas — thanks for the clear asks. Quick responses inline below and attached an updated COI copy + an updated subcontractor roster.

- COI: updated file includes the certificate-holder text you provided. See attached rivetcloud_coi_endorsed.pdf.
- Endorsements: our broker can issue the Additional Insured endorsement and primary/non-contributory wording for GL. Waiver of subrogation on WC is possible where applicable — need to confirm with specific subs.
- Cyber/E&O: current policy limits are $1.5M aggregate for cyber and $1M for E&O. Our security team is preparing a short risk summary; if Redwood needs $2M minimum, let us know if a risk acceptance memo will suffice or if we must increase limits.
- Timing: we can push the endorsed COI through broker Docusign today. Here's the envelope link: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/ABC123DEF

Attachments: rivetcloud_coi_endorsed.pdf (pdf), subcontractor_list_v2.csv (csv)

Would appreciate confirmation that the COI + endorsement will let you issue a conditional PO. If Redwood needs the cyber limit increased to $2M, we can provide a timeline for that but it may add ~2 weeks.

Best,
Carmen Diaz
Head of Operations
RivetCloud
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: RivetCloud Ops <ops@rivetcloud.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RivetCloud onboarding: initial docs & COI attached

Hi Carmen — thanks for the quick update and for sending the endorsed COI. Confirming next steps from Procurement: 

- Certificate holder text is correct as provided.
- Cyber/E&O: Redwood's standard minimum is $2M. Given your current $1.5M cyber / $1M E&O, we can proceed with a risk exception for onboarding on a conditional basis if you provide a short security attestation (one page) describing controls and the retroactive date. Our security team will review the attestation and advise if a permanent exception is allowable.
- Conditional PO: we will issue a conditional PO (PO-8764) to allow you to begin work while we finalize the security review. Conditional PO will be valid for 30 days; final PO will require either (a) an updated policy showing $2M cyber or (b) an approved risk acceptance memo from our security team.

Please sign the attached conditional PO and return via the DocuSign link. Also include the signed SOW when you can. Once the signed PO is back and the endorsed COI is in our files, we will kick off vendor activation.

Attachments: conditional_po_PO-8764.pdf (pdf)

Thanks and welcome aboard — looking forward to a smooth launch.

Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
